            if isinstance(cmd, str):
                cmd_args = cmd.split()

    except Exception as e:

        print(f"Error details: {str(e)}")
        # Don't exit on failure, just report and continue

def install_or_prompt(tool, win_url=None, mac_cmd=None, linux_cmd=None):
    if is_installed(tool):
        print(f"{tool} is installed")
        return

    print(f"{tool} is not installed")
    system = platform.system()
    
    if system == "Windows":
        if tool == "git":
            run_cmd("winget install --id Git.Git -e --silent")
        elif tool == "python":
            run_cmd("winget install --id Python.Python.3 -e --silent")
        else:
            print(f"Please install {tool} from: {win_url}")
            webbrowser.open(win_url)
            input(f"Press Enter after you've installed {tool}...")
    elif system == "Darwin" and mac_cmd:  # macOS
        run_cmd(mac_cmd)
    elif system == "Linux" and linux_cmd:
        run_cmd(linux_cmd)
    else:
        print(f"Please install {tool} manually.")
        sys.exit(1)

    # Verify installation was successful
    if not is_installed(tool):
        print(f"Installation of {tool} seems to have failed. Please install manually.")
        sys.exit(1)

def check_repo_exists(repo_name, token, username):
    print(f"Checking if repository {repo_name} exists...")
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"token {token}",
        "Accept": "application/vnd.github.v3+json"
    }
    
    try:
        response = requests.get(f"https://api.github.com/repos/{username}/{repo_name}", headers=headers)
        return response.status_code == 200
    except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
        print(f"Network error when checking repo: {str(e)}")
        sys.exit(1)

def create_repo(repo_name, token, username):
    # First check if repo exists
    if check_repo_exists(repo_name, token, username):
        print(f"Repository {repo_name} already exists, skipping creation.")
        return True
        
    print(f"Creating GitHub repo: {repo_name}")
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"token {token}",
        "Accept": "application/vnd.github.v3+json"
    }
    data = {"name": repo_name, "private": False}
    try:
        r = requests.post("https://api.github.com/user/repos", headers=headers, json=data)
        if r.status_code == 201:
            print(f"Repo {repo_name} created successfully.")
            return True
        elif r.status_code == 422 and "already exists" in r.text:
            print(f"Repo {repo_name} already exists.")
            return True
        else:
            print(f"Error creating repo: {r.status_code}")
            print(f"Response: {r.text}")
            return False
    except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
        print(f"Network error when creating repo: {str(e)}")
        return False

def remove_readonly(func, path, _):
    """Clear the readonly bit and reattempt the removal"""
    os.chmod(path, stat.S_IWRITE)
    func(path)

def safe_remove_folder(folder_path):
    """Safely remove a folder, handling git repositories and read-only files"""
    if not os.path.exists(folder_path):
        return True
    
    print(f"Removing existing folder: {folder_path}")
    
    # First try to reset git if it's a git repo
    if os.path.exists(os.path.join(folder_path, ".git")):
        try:
            # Try to clean git and release locks
            run_cmd("git reset --hard", cwd=folder_path)
            run_cmd("git clean -fd", cwd=folder_path)
        except:
            # Continue even if git commands fail
            pass
    
    # Wait a moment to ensure processes are closed
    time.sleep(1)
    
    # Try multiple removal methods
    try_count = 0
    max_tries = 3
    while try_count < max_tries and os.path.exists(folder_path):
        try_count += 1
        try:
            print(f"Removal attempt {try_count}/{max_tries}...")
            
            # Try using shutil
            try:
                shutil.rmtree(folder_path)
                if not os.path.exists(folder_path):
                    return True
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Standard removal failed: {str(e)}")
            
            # Try with onerror handler
            try:
                shutil.rmtree(folder_path, onerror=remove_readonly)
                if not os.path.exists(folder_path):
                    return True
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Enhanced removal failed: {str(e)}")
            
            # Try system command if still exists
            if platform.system() == "Windows" and os.path.exists(folder_path):
                try:
                    # Force using system command 
                    os.system(f'rd /s /q "{folder_path}"')
                    if not os.path.exists(folder_path):
                        return True
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"System command removal failed: {str(e)}")
            
            # Small delay between attempts
            time.sleep(2)
            
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Removal attempt {try_count} failed: {str(e)}")
    
    # If we still can't remove it, ask the user what to do
    if os.path.exists(folder_path):
        print(f"Warning: Could not remove folder {folder_path} after {max_tries} attempts")
        return False
    
    return True

def unzip_and_push(zip_name, repo_name, token, username, repo_exists=False):
    folder = Path(zip_name).stem
    
    # Clean up existing folder if it exists
    if not safe_remove_folder(folder):
        user_input = input(f"Folder '{folder}' could not be removed. Continue anyway? (y/n): ")
        if user_input.lower() != 'y':

            return False
    
    # Unzip the file using Python's built-in zipfile module
    print(f"Unzipping {zip_name}...")
    try:

    except zipfile.BadZipFile:

        return False
    except Exception as e:

        return False

    try:

                        # If copy fails, we'll initialize a new git repo

            # Go back to working folder

                # Use double quotes for Windows compatibility

                if commit_success:

                    success = push_success
                else:

                    success = True  # Consider it a success if there were no changes

                print("Falling back to repository recreation...")
                repo_exists = False

            run_cmd("git init")
            run_cmd("git add --all")
            run_cmd("git config --local user.email \"auto@example.com\"")
            run_cmd("git config --local user.name \"Auto Publisher\"")
            # Use double quotes for Windows compatibility

            if commit_success:
                run_cmd("git branch -M main")
                # Use https token authentication with quotes around URL

                    success = push_success

        success = False
    finally:

    return success

The Notion API version is hardcoded to "2022-06-28". If Notion updates their API, this might need to be updated.

7. Make the Notion API version configurable

    });
  },
  get(key, type = 'pages') {
    const item = this[type].get(key);
    if (!item) return null;
    
    // Check if cache is still valid
    if (Date.now() - item.timestamp > this.ttl) {
      this[type].delete(key);
      return null;
    }
    
    return item.value;

  });
};

// === Retry Logic ===
async function apiCallWithRetry(fn, maxRetries = 3) {
  let retries = 0;
  while (true) {
    try {

      if (error.response?.status === 429 && retries < maxRetries) {

function chunkContent(content, wordsPerChunk = 500) {
  // Handle empty or null content
  if (!content) return [];
  
  // Split content into words
  const words = content.split(/\s+/);
  const chunks = [];
  
  // Process chunks of specified word count
  for (let i = 0; i < words.length; i += wordsPerChunk) {
    const chunk = words.slice(i, i + wordsPerChunk).join(' ');
    chunks.push(chunk);
  }
  
  return chunks;
}

function extractImagesFromContent(content) {

  // Add text chunks as paragraph blocks

// === Full Notion Integration: Core Routes + Memory Extensions ===
const express = require("express");
const router = express.Router();
const axios = require("axios");

// === Environment Variables Validation ===
const requiredEnvVars = ['NOTION_TOKEN', 'NOTION_PARENT_PAGE_ID'];
for (const varName of requiredEnvVars) {
  if (!process.env[varName]) {
    console.error(`❌ Missing required environment variable: ${varName}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

const notionToken = process.env.NOTION_TOKEN;
const notionParentPageId = process.env.NOTION_PARENT_PAGE_ID;
const notionDatabaseId = process.env.NOTION_DATABASE_ID;
const notionMemoryDBId = process.env.GPT_MEMORY;

// === Create Axios Instance with Default Configuration ===
const notionApi = axios.create({
  baseURL: 'https://api.notion.com/v1',
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${notionToken}`,
    "Notion-Version": "2022-06-28",
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  }
});

// === Caching Setup ===
const cache = {
  pages: new Map(),
  titles: new Map(),
  ttl: 1000 * 60 * 5, // 5 minutes
  set(key, value, type = 'pages') {
    this[type].set(key, {
      value,
      timestamp: Date.now()
    });
  },
  get(key, type = 'pages') {
    const item = this[type].get(key);
    if (!item) return null;
    
    // Check if cache is still valid
    if (Date.now() - item.timestamp > this.ttl) {
      this[type].delete(key);
      return null;
    }
    
    return item.value;
  },
  invalidate(key, type = 'pages') {
    this[type].delete(key);
  },
  clear() {
    this.pages.clear();
    this.titles.clear();
  }
};

// === Error Handling Helper ===
const handleApiError = (res, error, context) => {
  console.error(`❌ ${context} error:`, error.response?.data || error.message);
  res.status(error.response?.status || 500).json({ 
    error: error.response?.data || error.message,
    context
  });
};

// === Retry Logic ===
async function apiCallWithRetry(fn, maxRetries = 3) {
  let retries = 0;
  while (true) {
    try {
      return await fn();
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.response?.status === 429 && retries < maxRetries) {
        const delay = Math.pow(2, retries) * 1000;
        console.log(`Rate limited, retrying in ${delay}ms...`);
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delay));
        retries++;
      } else {
        throw error;
      }
    }
  }
}

// === Block Creation Helpers ===
function createParagraphBlock(content) {
  return {
    object: "block",
    type: "paragraph",
    paragraph: {
      rich_text: [{ type: "text", text: { content } }]
    }
  };
}

function createHeadingBlock(content, level = 1) {
  const headingType = `heading_${level}`;
  return {
    object: "block",
    type: headingType,
    [headingType]: {
      rich_text: [{ type: "text", text: { content } }]
    }
  };
}

// === Content Chunking Utilities ===
// Function to split content into chunks of approximately 500 words
function chunkContent(content, wordsPerChunk = 500) {
  // Handle empty or null content
  if (!content) return [];
  
  // Split content into words
  const words = content.split(/\s+/);
  const chunks = [];
  
  // Process chunks of specified word count
  for (let i = 0; i < words.length; i += wordsPerChunk) {
    const chunk = words.slice(i, i + wordsPerChunk).join(' ');
    chunks.push(chunk);
  }
  
  return chunks;
}

// Extract images from content and return content without images and image array
function extractImagesFromContent(content) {
  // Basic regex to find markdown image syntax ![alt](url)
  // This can be expanded for other image formats as needed
  const imageRegex = /!\[(.*?)\]\((.*?)\)/g;
  const images = [];
  let match;
  
  // Extract all images
  while ((match = imageRegex.exec(content)) !== null) {
    images.push({
      alt: match[1],
      url: match[2],
      fullMatch: match[0]
    });
  }
  
  // Remove images from content
  const contentWithoutImages = content.replace(imageRegex, '');
  
  return { contentWithoutImages, images };
}

// Create image block for Notion
function createImageBlock(imageUrl, caption = '') {
  return {
    object: "block",
    type: "image",
    image: {
      type: "external",
      external: {
        url: imageUrl
      },
      caption: caption ? [{ type: "text", text: { content: caption } }] : []
    }
  };
}

// Function to create blocks for chunked content
async function createBlocksFromChunkedContent(content) {
  // Extract images first
  const { contentWithoutImages, images } = extractImagesFromContent(content);
  
  // Chunk the text content
  const textChunks = chunkContent(contentWithoutImages);
  
  // Create blocks array
  const blocks = [];
  
  // Add text chunks as paragraph blocks
  for (const chunk of textChunks) {
    blocks.push(createParagraphBlock(chunk));
  }
  
  // Add images one by one
  for (const image of images) {
    try {
      blocks.push(createImageBlock(image.url, image.alt));
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn(`⚠️ Failed to process image ${image.url}: ${error.message}`);
      // Add a placeholder text mentioning the image
      blocks.push(createParagraphBlock(`[Image: ${image.alt || 'No description'} (${image.url})]`));
    }
  }
  
  return blocks;
}

// Process content in batches to avoid Notion API limits
async function appendBlocksInBatches(pageId, blocks, batchSize = 100) {
  for (let i = 0; i < blocks.length; i += batchSize) {
    const batch = blocks.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    
    await apiCallWithRetry(() => 
      notionApi.patch(`/blocks/${pageId}/children`, {
        children: batch
      })
    );
    
    // Small delay between batches to avoid rate limiting
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
  }
}

async function findPageByTitle(title) {

// === Pagination helper ===
async function paginatedRequest(endpoint, params = {}, pageSize = 100) {
  let results = [];
  let hasMore = true;
  let startCursor = undefined;
  
  while (hasMore) {
    const queryParams = { ...params, page_size: pageSize };
    if (startCursor) {
      queryParams.start_cursor = startCursor;
    }
    
    const response = await apiCallWithRetry(() => {
      if (endpoint === 'search') {
        return notionApi.post('/search', queryParams);
      } else {
        const url = endpoint.startsWith('/') ? endpoint : `/${endpoint}`;
        return notionApi.get(url, { params: queryParams });
      }
    });
    
    results = results.concat(response.data.results);
    hasMore = response.data.has_more;
    startCursor = response.data.next_cursor;
    
    // Safety check to prevent infinite loops
    if (results.length > 1000) {
      console.warn('Pagination limit reached (1000 items)');
      break;
    }
  }
  
  return results;
}

    }

    // Use a Map to deduplicate pages by ID while keeping the most informative entry
    const pagesMap = new Map();

      const titleRegex = new RegExp(`^${safeTitle}\\s+(\\d+)$`);

      // Search for all pages with similar titles

        notionApi.post('/search', {
          query: baseTitle,
          filter: { property: "object", value: "page" }

      let highestVersion = 0;
      const versionMap = new Map();

        const extractedTitle = await extractPageTitle(page);

          if (match) {

            if (!isNaN(version)) {

      const versionSuffix = newVersion < 10 ? `0${newVersion}` : `${newVersion}`;

        if (attempt < maxVersionAttempts) {
          console.log(`Retrying version creation (attempt ${attempt + 1}/${maxVersionAttempts})...`);
          // Wait with exponential backoff
          await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, Math.pow(2, attempt) * 500));
          return createVersionedPage(baseTitle, content, attempt + 1);
        }

const http = require('http');

- `dotenv` (for environment variables)
- `path` (for file path operations with your OpenAPI spec)

Unless you plan to use the `http` module directly for some custom functionality later, you can remove that import to keep your code clean.

const express = require("express");
const router = express.Router();
const axios = require("axios");

const notionToken = process.env.NOTION_TOKEN;
const notionParentPageId = process.env.NOTION_PARENT_PAGE_ID;
const notionDatabaseId = process.env.NOTION_DATABASE_ID;

// === Utility: Enhanced title extraction function ===
async function extractPageTitle(page) {
  // Try to extract title from properties first (for pages and databases)
  if (page.properties) {
    // Check all title-like properties in descending order of likelihood
    const titleProps = ['title', 'Name', 'Feature', 'Title'];
    
    for (const prop of titleProps) {
      const titleArray = page.properties[prop]?.title;
      if (titleArray && titleArray.length > 0) {
        const textContent = titleArray[0]?.plain_text || titleArray[0]?.text?.content;
        if (textContent) {
          console.log(`✅ Found title in properties.${prop}: "${textContent}"`);
          return textContent;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  // For direct title property (older Notion API format)
  if (page.title) {
    if (Array.isArray(page.title) && page.title.length > 0) {
      const textContent = page.title[0]?.plain_text || page.title[0]?.text?.content;
      if (textContent) {
        console.log(`✅ Found title in direct title array: "${textContent}"`);
        return textContent;
      }
    } else if (typeof page.title === 'string') {
      console.log(`✅ Found string title: "${page.title}"`);
      return page.title;
    }
  }

  // Try to get from page object
  const pageTitle = page.child_page?.title;
  if (pageTitle) {
    console.log(`✅ Found title in child_page: "${pageTitle}"`);
    return pageTitle;
  }

  // Last resort: Extract from page content
  return await extractTitleFromBlocks(page.id);
}

// === Utility: Enhanced title extraction from blocks ===
async function extractTitleFromBlocks(pageId) {
  try {
    const response = await axios.get(
      `https://api.notion.com/v1/blocks/${pageId}/children?page_size=50`,
      {
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${notionToken}`,
          "Notion-Version": "2022-06-28",
          "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
      }
    );

    const blocks = response.data.results;
    
    // First check for a child_page with title
    const childPageBlock = blocks.find(block => block.type === "child_page");
    if (childPageBlock?.child_page?.title) {
      const title = childPageBlock.child_page.title;
      console.log(`📄 Found child page title: ${title}`);
      return title;
    }
    
    // Look for the first heading block
    const headingTypes = ["heading_1", "heading_2", "heading_3"];
    const headingBlock = blocks.find(block => headingTypes.includes(block.type));
    
    if (headingBlock) {
      const blockType = headingBlock.type;
      const richText = headingBlock[blockType]?.rich_text || [];
      const title = richText.map(rt => rt.text?.content).join("").trim();
      
      if (title) {
        console.log(`✅ Found title in ${blockType}: "${title}"`);
        return title;
      }
    }
    
    // Try to get first paragraph text as fallback
    const paragraphBlock = blocks.find(block => block.type === "paragraph");
    if (paragraphBlock) {
      const richText = paragraphBlock.paragraph?.rich_text || [];
      const title = richText.map(rt => rt.text?.content).join("").trim();
      
      if (title) {
        console.log(`✅ Found title in paragraph: "${title}"`);
        return title;
      }
    }

    // Get page info directly as last resort
    try {
      const pageInfo = await axios.get(
        `https://api.notion.com/v1/pages/${pageId}`,
        {
          headers: {
            Authorization: `Bearer ${notionToken}`,
            "Notion-Version": "2022-06-28",
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
          }
        }
      );
      
      // Try to find any property that might contain a title
      const properties = pageInfo.data.properties;
      if (properties) {
        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(properties)) {
          if (value.title && value.title.length > 0) {
            const title = value.title[0]?.plain_text || value.title[0]?.text?.content;
            if (title) {
              console.log(`✅ Found title in page properties.${key}: "${title}"`);
              return title;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`❌ Failed to fetch page info for ${pageId}:`, err.message);
    }

    console.log(`⚠️ No usable title found for ${pageId}`);
    return `Untitled Page (${pageId.substring(0, 8)})`;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`❌ Title extraction failed for ${pageId}:`, err.message);
    return `Untitled Page (${pageId.substring(0, 8)})`;
  }
}

// === Utility: Enhanced child pages extraction ===
async function extractChildPages(pageId, pages = [], visited = new Set()) {
  if (visited.has(pageId)) return;
  visited.add(pageId);

  try {
    const response = await axios.get(
      `https://api.notion.com/v1/blocks/${pageId}/children?page_size=100`,
      {
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${notionToken}`,
          "Notion-Version": "2022-06-28",
          "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
      }
    );

    const blocks = response.data.results;
    console.log(`🧱 Blocks for page ${pageId}:`);

    for (const block of blocks) {
      const blockType = block.type;

      if (blockType === "child_page") {
        const childId = block.id;
        let childTitle = block.child_page?.title;
        
        // If no title in the initial response, try to extract it
        if (!childTitle || childTitle === "(no title)") {
          try {
            const pageInfo = await axios.get(
              `https://api.notion.com/v1/pages/${childId}`,
              {
                headers: {
                  Authorization: `Bearer ${notionToken}`,
                  "Notion-Version": "2022-06-28", 
                  "Content-Type": "application/json"
                }
              }
            );
            childTitle = await extractPageTitle(pageInfo.data) || childTitle || "(no title)";
          } catch (err) {
            console.error(`❌ Failed to fetch child page info for ${childId}:`, err.message);
          }
        }

        const parentId = pageId;

        pages.push({
          id: childId,
          title: childTitle || "(no title)",
          parent: parentId,
          type: "page"
        });

        console.log(`📄 Found child page: ${childTitle} (ID: ${childId})`);

        await extractChildPages(childId, pages, visited); // recurse
      }

      const richText = block[blockType]?.rich_text || [];
      const text = richText.map(rt => rt.text?.content).join("") || "(no text)";
      console.log(`- [${blockType}] ${text}`);
    }

    return pages;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`❌ Failed to fetch children for ${pageId}:`, err.message);
    return pages;
  }
}

// === List Pages (Enhanced) ===
router.get("/list-pages", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const response = await axios.post(
      "https://api.notion.com/v1/search",
      { page_size: 100 },
      {
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${notionToken}`,
          "Notion-Version": "2022-06-28",
          "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
      }
    );

    const basePages = await Promise.all(
      response.data.results.map(async (item) => {
        const title = await extractPageTitle(item) || `Untitled (${item.id.substring(0, 8)})`;

        return {
          title,
          id: item.id,
          type: item.object,
          parent: item.parent?.page_id || item.parent?.database_id || null,
          url: item.url || null
        };
      })
    );

    const childPages = [];
    for (const base of basePages) {
      await extractChildPages(base.id, childPages);
    }

    // Use a Map to deduplicate pages by ID while keeping the most informative entry
    const pagesMap = new Map();
    
    // First add all base pages
    for (const page of basePages) {
      pagesMap.set(page.id, page);
    }
    
    // Then add child pages, but don't overwrite if the existing entry has a title
    // and the new one doesn't
    for (const page of childPages) {
      const existingPage = pagesMap.get(page.id);
      
      if (!existingPage || 
          (page.title && page.title !== "(no title)" && 
           (!existingPage.title || existingPage.title === "(no title)" || existingPage.title.includes("Untitled")))) {
        pagesMap.set(page.id, page);
      }
    }
    
    const uniquePages = Array.from(pagesMap.values());

    console.log(`🧠 Found ${uniquePages.length} Notion pages:\n`);
    for (const page of uniquePages) {
      console.log(`[Type: ${page.type}] Title: ${page.title}`);
      console.log(`   ID: ${page.id}`);
      if (page.parent) console.log(`   Parent: ${page.parent}`);
      if (page.url) console.log(`   URL: ${page.url}`);
      console.log();
    }

    res.json({ success: true, count: uniquePages.length, pages: uniquePages });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("❌ list-pages error:", error.response?.data || error.message);
    res.status(500).json({ error: error.response?.data || error.message });
  }
});

// === Query Database ===
router.get("/query-database", async (req, res) => {
  const databaseId = notionDatabaseId;

  if (!databaseId) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: "Missing NOTION_DATABASE_ID in secrets." });
  }

  try {
    const response = await axios.post(
      `https://api.notion.com/v1/databases/${databaseId}/query`,
      {},
      {
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${notionToken}`,
          "Notion-Version": "2022-06-28",
          "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
      }
    );

    const rows = await Promise.all(response.data.results.map(async (item) => {
      const title = await extractPageTitle(item) || `Untitled (${item.id.substring(0, 8)})`;

      return {
        title,
        id: item.id,
        type: item.object,
        parent: item.parent?.database_id || null,
        url: item.url || null
      };
    }));

    res.json({ success: true, count: rows.length, entries: rows });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("❌ query-database error:", error.response?.data || error.message);
    res.status(500).json({ error: error.response?.data || error.message });
  }
});

// === Create a Standalone Page ===
router.post("/create-standalone-page", async (req, res) => {
  const { title, content } = req.body;

  try {
    const response = await axios.post(
      "https://api.notion.com/v1/pages",
      {
        parent: { type: "page_id", page_id: notionParentPageId },
        properties: {
          title: [
            {
              type: "text",
              text: { content: title }
            }
          ]
        },
        children: [
          {
            object: "block",
            type: "heading_1",
            heading_1: {
              rich_text: [{ type: "text", text: { content: title } }]
            }
          },
          {
            object: "block",
            type: "paragraph",
            paragraph: {
              rich_text: [{ type: "text", text: { content } }]
            }
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${notionToken}`,
          "Notion-Version": "2022-06-28",
          "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
      }
    );

    res.json({ success: true, pageId: response.data.id });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("❌ create-standalone-page error:", error.response?.data || error.message);
    res.status(500).json({ error: error.response?.data || error.message });
  }
});

// === Append to Page by Title ===
router.patch("/append-to-page-by-title", async (req, res) => {
  const { title, content } = req.body;

  try {
    const searchResponse = await axios.post(
      "https://api.notion.com/v1/search",
      {
        query: title,
        filter: { property: "object", value: "page" }
      },
      {
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${notionToken}`,
          "Notion-Version": "2022-06-28",
          "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
      }
    );

    const normalizedInput = title.trim().toLowerCase();

    // Use the enhanced title extraction for better matching
    const pages = await Promise.all(searchResponse.data.results.map(async (page) => {
      const extractedTitle = await extractPageTitle(page);
      return {
        page,
        title: extractedTitle
      };
    }));

    const match = pages.find(item => 
      item.title && item.title.trim().toLowerCase() === normalizedInput
    );

    let pageId;

    if (!match) {
      console.warn(`Creating new page titled "${title}"...`);
      const createRes = await axios.post(
        "https://api.notion.com/v1/pages",
        {
          parent: { type: "page_id", page_id: notionParentPageId },
          properties: {
            title: [
              {
                type: "text",
                text: { content: title }
              }
            ]
          }
        },
        {
          headers: {
            Authorization: `Bearer ${notionToken}`,
            "Notion-Version": "2022-06-28",
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
          }
        }
      );

      pageId = createRes.data.id;
    } else {
      pageId = match.page.id;
    }

    await axios.patch(
      `https://api.notion.com/v1/blocks/${pageId}/children`,
      {
        children: [
          {
            object: "block",
            type: "paragraph",
            paragraph: {
              rich_text: [
                {
                  type: "text",
                  text: { content }
                }
              ]
            }
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${notionToken}`,
          "Notion-Version": "2022-06-28",
          "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
      }
    );

    res.json({ success: true, pageId });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("❌ append-to-page error:", error.response?.data || error.message);
    res.status(500).json({ error: error.response?.data || error.message });
  }
});

// === Archive Page ===
router.delete("/page/:id", async (req, res) => {
  const pageId = req.params.id;

  try {
    await axios.patch(
      `https://api.notion.com/v1/pages/${pageId}`,
      { archived: true },
      {
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${notionToken}`,
          "Notion-Version": "2022-06-28",
          "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
      }
    );

    res.json({ success: true, archived: true });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("❌ archive-page error:", error.response?.data || error.message);
    res.status(500).json({ error: error.response?.data || error.message });
  }
});

module.exports = router;
</antArtifact>

router.get("/query-database", async (req, res) => {
  const databaseId = notionDatabaseId;

  if (!databaseId) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: "Missing NOTION_DATABASE_ID in secrets." });
  }

  try {
    const response = await axios.post(
      `https://api.notion.com/v1/databases/${databaseId}/query`,
      {},
      {
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${notionToken}`,
          "Notion-Version": "2022-06-28",
          "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
      }
    );

    const rows = await Promise.all(response.data.results.map(async (item) => {
      const title = await extractPageTitle(item) || `Untitled (${item.id.substring(0, 8)})`;

      return {
        title,
        id: item.id,
        type: item.object,
        parent: item.parent?.database_id || null,
        url: item.url || null
      };
    }));

    res.json({ success: true, count: rows.length, entries: rows });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("❌ query-database error:", error.response?.data || error.message);
    res.status(500).json({ error: error.response?.data || error.message });
  }
});

// === Create a Standalone Page ===
router.post("/create-standalone-page", async (req, res) => {
  const { title, content } = req.body;

  try {
    const response = await axios.post(
      "https://api.notion.com/v1/pages",
      {
        parent: { type: "page_id", page_id: notionParentPageId },
        properties: {
          title: [
            {
              type: "text",
              text: { content: title }
            }
          ]
        },
        children: [

            object: "block",
            type: "heading_1",
            heading_1: {
              rich_text: [{ type: "text", text: { content: title } }]
            }
          },
          {
            object: "block",
            type: "paragraph",
            paragraph: {
              rich_text: [{ type: "text", text: { content } }]
            }
          }

router.patch("/append-to-page-by-title", async (req, res) => {
  const { title, content } = req.body;

  try {
    const searchResponse = await axios.post(
      "https://api.notion.com/v1/search",
      {
        query: title,
        filter: { property: "object", value: "page" }
      },
      {
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${notionToken}`,
          "Notion-Version": "2022-06-28",
          "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
      }
    );

    const normalizedInput = title.trim().toLowerCase();

    // Use the enhanced title extraction for better matching
    const pages = await Promise.all(searchResponse.data.results.map(async (page) => {
      const extractedTitle = await extractPageTitle(page);
      return {
        page,
        title: extractedTitle
      };
    }));

    const match = pages.find(item => 
      item.title && item.title.trim().toLowerCase() === normalizedInput
    );

    let pageId;

    if (!match) {
      console.warn(`Creating new page titled "${title}"...`);
      const createRes = await axios.post(
        "https://api.notion.com/v1/pages",
        {
          parent: { type: "page_id", page_id: notionParentPageId },
          properties: {
            title: [
              {
                type: "text",
                text: { content: title }
              }
            ]
          }
        },
        {
          headers: {
            Authorization: `Bearer ${notionToken}`,
            "Notion-Version": "2022-06-28",
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
          }
        }
      );

      pageId = createRes.data.id;
    } else {
      pageId = match.page.id;
    }

    await axios.patch(
      `https://api.notion.com/v1/blocks/${pageId}/children`,
      {
        children: [
          {
            object: "block",
            type: "paragraph",
            paragraph: {
              rich_text: [

                  type: "text",
                  text: { content }
                }
              ]
            }
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${notionToken}`,
          "Notion-Version": "2022-06-28",
          "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
      }
    );

    res.json({ success: true, pageId });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("❌ append-to-page error:", error.response?.data || error.message);
    res.status(500).json({ error: error.response?.data || error.message });
  }
});

  const pageId = req.params.id;

  try {
    await axios.patch(
      `https://api.notion.com/v1/pages/${pageId}`,
      { archived: true },
      {
        headers: {

          "Notion-Version": "2022-06-28",
          "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
      }
    );

    res.json({ success: true, archived: true });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("❌ archive-page error:", error.response?.data || error.message);
    res.status(500).json({ error: error.response?.data || error.message });
  }
});

function handleRateLimit(error, res) {
  if (error.response?.status === 403 && error.response?.data?.message?.includes('API rate limit exceeded')) {
    return res.status(429).json({ 
      error: "GitHub API rate limit exceeded, please try again later",
      reset_at: error.response.headers['x-ratelimit-reset']
    });
  }
  // Handle other errors
  const status = error.response?.status || 500;
  res.status(status).json({
    error: error.response?.data?.message || error.message,
    status: status,
    documentation_url: error.response?.data?.documentation_url
  });
}

// Default axios options
const axiosOptions = {
  headers,
  timeout: 10000 // 10 seconds
};

// === Create GitHub issue ===
router.post("/github/issue", async (req, res) => {
  if (!githubToken) {
    return res.status(401).json({ error: "GitHub token not configured" });
  }
  
  const { title, body } = req.body;
  
  if (!title) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: "Title is required" });
  }
  
  try {
    const response = await axios.post(
      `https://api.github.com/repos/${repoOwner}/${repoName}/issues`,
      { title, body },
      axiosOptions
    );
    res.json({ success: true, issueUrl: response.data.html_url });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("GitHub create issue error:", error.response?.data || error.message);
    handleRateLimit(error, res);
  }
});

// === Update GitHub issue ===
router.patch("/github/issue", async (req, res) => {
  if (!githubToken) {
    return res.status(401).json({ error: "GitHub token not configured" });
  }
  
  const { issue_number, title, body, state } = req.body;
  
  if (!issue_number) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: "Issue number is required" });
  }
  
  try {
    const response = await axios.patch(
      `https://api.github.com/repos/${repoOwner}/${repoName}/issues/${issue_number}`,
      { title, body, state },
      axiosOptions
    );
    res.json({ success: true, updated: response.data });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("GitHub update issue error:", error.response?.data || error.message);
    handleRateLimit(error, res);
  }
});

  if (!githubToken) {
    return res.status(401).json({ error: "GitHub token not configured" });
  }
  
  const { path, content, message, branch } = req.body;

      { ...axiosOptions, params }
    );

    };

  }
});

  if (!githubToken) {

  }
  
  const { page = 1, per_page = 30, state = 'all' } = req.query;

I'll review the notion.js file for errors of any kind - including syntax, context, function, flow, and any other potential issues.

## Overall Assessment

This appears to be a well-structured Express router implementation for Notion API integration. The code includes robust error handling, caching mechanisms, retry logic, and comprehensive functionality for working with Notion pages, databases, and a memory system.

## Potential Issues

1. **Required Environment Variables**
   - The code checks for `NOTION_TOKEN` and `NOTION_PARENT_PAGE_ID`, but then uses additional variables like `NOTION_DATABASE_ID` and `GPT_MEMORY` without validating their existence first.
   - For the routes that depend on these IDs, there are some checks, but it would be more consistent to validate all required environment variables at startup.

2. **Cache Without Expiration Cleanup**
   - The cache implementation checks for TTL on get operations, but there's no automatic cleanup mechanism. Over time, this could lead to memory leaks if many cached items expire but remain in memory.

3. **Infinite Recursion Risk**
   - In `extractChildPages`, there's a risk of infinite recursion if pages have circular references. Although there's a depth check (`depth > maxDepth`), it might be good to implement additional safeguards.

4. **Error Handling in Retry Logic**
   - The `apiCallWithRetry` function only retries on 429 status codes. Consider adding other retryable error codes like 503 or network errors.

5. **Route Consistency**
   - Some routes use PUT, some use PATCH for similar operations. For example, `"/write-page-by-title"` uses PUT while `"/append-to-page-by-title"` uses PATCH.
   - `"/delete-memory"` uses PUT method, which is unusual for a delete operation. Typically, DELETE would be used.

6. **Pagination Issues**
   - In `paginatedRequest`, there's a hard limit of 1000 items. This might be insufficient for large Notion workspaces. Consider allowing configurable limits.

7. **Missing Content Type Parsing**
   - When creating paragraph blocks, content is directly inserted without considering Notion's rich text capabilities. Long text might need to be broken down or else it could exceed Notion API limits.

8. **Possible Race Conditions**
   - In the versioning logic of `"/write-page-by-title"`, there's a potential race condition when checking for duplicates and then creating a version.

9. **Unnecessary Promise.all in createVersionedPage**
   - The `Promise.all` around `searchResults.data.results.map` seems unnecessary since the function inside the map is not async.

10. **Error Context Information**
    - The `handleApiError` function logs the error but only passes limited information to the client. More specific error details would be helpful for debugging.

11. **Log Pollution**
    - There's extensive logging which is good for development but might lead to log pollution in production. Consider adding log levels.

12. **Memory Database Safety**
    - When normalizing memory keys, the code uses `decodeURIComponent` which can throw errors if malformed URI components are passed. This should be wrapped in a try/catch.

13. **Memory Key Uniqueness**
    - The memory functions normalize keys but don't ensure uniqueness before creating entries. This could lead to duplicate keys in different formats.

14. **No Input Validation**
    - Several routes accept user input without proper validation, which could lead to security issues.

15. **No Rate Limiting**
    - While there's retry logic for rate limiting from Notion's side, there's no rate limiting implemented for the API itself to prevent abuse.

Despite these potential issues, the code is well-structured with good separation of concerns, comprehensive error handling, and a solid caching strategy. The functions for title extraction and page content management show thoughtful design for handling Notion's sometimes complex data structures.

There's an issue with how your POST request is formatted. The server processed it as a GET request to the root path (/) instead of a POST to "/github/issue" because the headers and body aren't properly separated.

When making an HTTP request, you need to include a blank line between the headers and the body. Here's how your request should be formatted:

```
POST /github/issue HTTP/1.1
Host: d0c53e96-6150-4d3d-b538-c5ac77230c6b-00-2kv1xkk27re2v.picard.replit.dev

}
```

Notice the empty line between `Content-Type: application/json` and the JSON object. Without this blank line, your entire JSON body is being treated as part of the headers, which is why the server processed it as a GET request to the root endpoint rather than a POST to "/github/issue".

If you're using a tool like cURL, Postman, or an HTTP client library, they typically handle this formatting automatically. If you're constructing the raw HTTP request yourself, make sure to include that blank line.

I'll analyze this Notion.js file thoroughly to check for errors, code quality, efficiency, and areas for improvement.

## Overall Assessment

The code is generally well-structured and implements a comprehensive set of routes for interacting with Notion's API. It includes good practices like:

- Environment variable validation
- Error handling with consistent response formats
- Caching to improve performance
- Retry logic with exponential backoff and jitter
- Content sanitization and validation
- Pagination handling

Let me break down the analysis into several key areas:

## Code Structure and Organization

The file is well-organized but quite large. Breaking it into multiple modules would improve maintainability:

- API helpers and utilities in a separate file
- Caching implementation in its own module
- Route handlers grouped by functionality (pages, memory, health checks)

## Potential Errors/Bugs

1. **Incomplete/Broken Code Segment** - Line 523-524: There's a truncated function call that leads to invalid code:
```javascript
for (const page of basePages) {
  pagesMap.set
  // Use a Map to deduplicate pages by ID while keeping the most informative entry
  const pagesMap = new Map();
```
This code redefines `pagesMap` after starting to use it, which would cause errors.

2. **Inconsistent Timeout Handling** - The code defines `CONFIG.API_TIMEOUT` but in some places creates a separate timeout promise, which might lead to race conditions in error handling.

3. **Missing Error Handling in Recursive Functions** - `extractChildPages` could potentially hit stack limits with deeply nested pages.

## Efficiency Concerns

1. **Cache Implementation Inefficiency**:
   - The cache cleanup runs on fixed intervals but also checks on each operation, which may be redundant
   - No size-based eviction strategy beyond numerical item count

2. **Excessive API Calls**:
   - Some operations like title extraction make multiple API calls when it could use data already retrieved

3. **Memory Management**:
   - No memory limits on `cache` which could lead to memory leaks in long-running processes

4. **Recursive Page Discovery**:
   - The recursive page traversal (`extractChildPages`) could be optimized with better batching

## Code Reuse Opportunities

1. **Block Creation Duplication**:
   - There's redundancy in page creation code across several routes
   - Could extract common page creation logic into a shared function

2. **Standardized Error Handling**:
   - While there's a central `handleApiError` function, some error paths don't use it

3. **API Response Processing**:
   - Several routes extract page titles in similar ways
   - Could create a helper function for consistently processing page objects

## Security Considerations

1. **Input Sanitization**:
   - The `sanitizeInput` function is good, but some routes don't consistently use it for all inputs

2. **Error Responses**:
   - Some error responses include internal details that could potentially expose implementation details

3. **Rate Limiting**:
   - No internal rate limiting to prevent abuse of the routes

## Recommendations

1. **Modularize the Code**:
   - Split into multiple files by responsibility
   - Create a class-based structure for better organization

2. **Improve Error Handling**:
   - Add more specific error types
   - Handle edge cases more consistently

3. **Optimize API Calls**:
   - Implement better batching for bulk operations
   - More aggressively cache API responses

4. **Enhance Caching Strategy**:
   - Implement LRU (Least Recently Used) cache eviction
   - Add time-to-live (TTL) options per cached item

5. **Fix the Map Duplication Bug**:
   - Correct the code around line 523-524 to properly implement page deduplication

6. **Add Metrics and Logging**:
   - Implement proper structured logging
   - Add timing metrics for performance monitoring

Overall, the code is well-implemented but would benefit from better organization into modules and fixing the identified issues, particularly the broken code around the Map implementation.

<antArtifact type="application/vnd.ant.code" language="javascript" identifier="page-helpers" title="src/utils/page-helpers.js">
const { notionApi, apiCallWithRetry } = require('./notion-api');
const { cache } = require('./cache');
const { CONFIG } = require('../config/notion-config');

// === Utility: Find Page by Title ===
async function findPageByTitle(title) {
  if (!title || typeof title !== 'string') {
    console.warn("Empty or invalid title provided to findPageByTitle");
    return null;
  }
  
  const normalizedInput = title.toLowerCase().trim();
  
  // Check cache first
  const cacheKey = `title:${normalizedInput}`;
  const cachedPage = cache.get(cacheKey);
  if (cachedPage) {
    return cachedPage;
  }
  
  try {
    const searchResponse = await apiCallWithRetry(() => 
      notionApi.post('/search', {
        query: title,
        filter: { property: "object", value: "page" },
        page_size: 10
      })
    );

    // No results
    if (!searchResponse.data.results.length) {
      return null;
    }

    // Use the enhanced title extraction for better matching
    const pages = await Promise.all(searchResponse.data.results.map(async (page) => {
      try {
        const extractedTitle = await extractPageTitle(page);
        return {
          page,
          title: extractedTitle
        };
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(`Error extracting title for page ${page.id}:`, err.message);
        return {
          page,
          title: `Untitled (${page.id.substring(0, 8)})`
        };
      }
    }));

    // Find exact match or closest match
    const exactMatch = pages.find(item => 
      item.title && item.title.toLowerCase() === normalizedInput
    );
    
    const match = exactMatch || null;
    
    // Cache the result
    if (match) {
      cache.set(cacheKey, match);
    }
    
    return match;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`❌ Find page error for "${title}":`, error.message);
    return null;
  }
}

// === Utility: Enhanced title extraction function ===
async function extractPageTitle(page) {
  if (!page) {
    console.warn("Cannot extract title: page object is undefined");
    return "Untitled Page";
  }
  
  // Check cache first
  const cacheKey = page.id;
  if (!cacheKey) {
    console.warn("Cannot cache page title: missing page ID");
    return extractTitleUncached(page);
  }
  
  const cachedTitle = cache.get(cacheKey, 'titles');
  if (cachedTitle) {
    return cachedTitle;
  }

  // Extract title using helper function
  const extractedTitle = await extractTitleUncached(page);
  
  // Cache the result
  if (extractedTitle && cacheKey) {
    cache.set(cacheKey, extractedTitle, 'titles');
  }

  return extractedTitle;
}

// Helper function for title extraction logic
async function extractTitleUncached(page) {
  // Try to extract title from properties first (for pages and databases)
  if (page.properties) {
    // Check all title-like properties in descending order of likelihood
    const titleProps = ['title', 'Name', 'Feature', 'Title'];

    for (const prop of titleProps) {
      const titleArray = page.properties[prop]?.title;
      if (titleArray && titleArray.length > 0) {
        const textContent = titleArray[0]?.plain_text || titleArray[0]?.text?.content;
        if (textContent) {
          console.log(`✅ Found title in properties.${prop}: "${textContent}"`);
          return textContent;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // For direct title property (older Notion API format)
  if (page.title) {
    if (Array.isArray(page.title) && page.title.length > 0) {
      const textContent = page.title[0]?.plain_text || page.title[0]?.text?.content;
      if (textContent) {
        console.log(`✅ Found title in direct title array: "${textContent}"`);
        return textContent;
      }
    } else if (typeof page.title === 'string') {
      console.log(`✅ Found string title: "${page.title}"`);
      return page.title;
    }
  }

  // Try to get from page object
  if (page.child_page?.title) {
    console.log(`✅ Found title in child_page: "${page.child_page.title}"`);
    return page.child_page.title;
  }

  // Last resort: Extract from page content
  if (page.id) {
    try {
      return await extractTitleFromBlocks(page.id);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`❌ Failed to extract title from blocks for ${page.id}:`, err.message);
      return `Untitled Page (${page.id.substring(0, 8)})`;
    }
  }

  return `Untitled Page (${page.id ? page.id.substring(0, 8) : 'unknown'})`;
}

// === Utility: Enhanced title extraction from blocks ===
async function extractTitleFromBlocks(pageId) {
  try {
    const response = await apiCallWithRetry(() => 
      notionApi.get(`/blocks/${pageId}/children?page_size=50`)
    );

    const blocks = response.data.results;

    // First check for a child_page with title
    const childPageBlock = blocks.find(block => block.type === "child_page");
    if (childPageBlock?.child_page?.title) {
      const title = childPageBlock.child_page.title;
      console.log(`📄 Found child page title: ${title}`);
      return title;
    }

    // Look for the first heading block
    const headingTypes = ["heading_1", "heading_2", "heading_3"];
    const headingBlock = blocks.find(block => headingTypes.includes(block.type));

    if (headingBlock) {
      const blockType = headingBlock.type;
      const richText = headingBlock[blockType]?.rich_text || [];
      const title = richText.map(rt => rt.text?.content || '').join("").trim();

      if (title) {
        console.log(`✅ Found title in ${blockType}: "${title}"`);
        return title;
      }
    }

    // Try to get first paragraph text as fallback
    const paragraphBlock = blocks.find(block => block.type === "paragraph");
    if (paragraphBlock) {
      const richText = paragraphBlock.paragraph?.rich_text || [];
      const title = richText.map(rt => rt.text?.content || '').join("").trim();

      if (title) {
        console.log(`✅ Found title in paragraph: "${title}"`);
        return title;
      }
    }

    // Get page info directly as last resort
    try {
      const pageInfo = await apiCallWithRetry(() => 
        notionApi.get(`/pages/${pageId}`)
      );

      // Try to find any property that might contain a title
      const properties = pageInfo.data.properties;
      if (properties) {
        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(properties)) {
          if (value.title && value.title.length > 0) {
            const title = value.title[0]?.plain_text || value.title[0]?.text?.content;
            if (title) {
              console.log(`✅ Found title in page properties.${key}: "${title}"`);
              return title;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`❌ Failed to fetch page info for ${pageId}:`, err.message);
    }

    console.log(`⚠️ No usable title found for ${pageId}`);
    return `Untitled Page (${pageId.substring(0, 8)})`;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`❌ Title extraction failed for ${pageId}:`, err.message);
    return `Untitled Page (${pageId.substring(0, 8)})`;
  }
}

// === Utility: Enhanced child pages extraction with controlled recursion ===
async function extractChildPages(pageId, pages = [], visited = new Set(), depth = 0, maxDepth = 3) {
  // Guard against invalid pageId or excessive recursion
  if (!pageId || visited.has(pageId) || depth > maxDepth) {
    return pages;
  }
  
  // Protect against infinite recursion
  visited.add(pageId);
  
  // Track recursion depth for debugging
  const indentation = "  ".repeat(depth);
  console.log(`${indentation}🔍 Exploring page ${pageId} (depth: ${depth}/${maxDepth})`);

  try {
    const response = await apiCallWithRetry(() => 
      notionApi.get(`/blocks/${pageId}/children?page_size=100`)
    );

    const blocks = response.data.results;
    
    const blockCount = blocks.length;
    console.log(`${indentation}🧱 Found ${blockCount} blocks in page ${pageId}`);

    // Process child pages specifically
    const childPagePromises = blocks
      .filter(block => block.type === "child_page")
      .map(async (block) => {
        const childId = block.id;
        
        // Skip if we already added this page
        if (pages.some(p => p.id === childId)) {
          console.log(`${indentation}⚠️ Duplicate page detected: ${childId}`);
          return null;
        }
        
        let childTitle = block.child_page?.title;

        // If no title in the initial response, try to extract it
        if (!childTitle || childTitle === "(no title)") {
          try {
            const pageInfo = await apiCallWithRetry(() => 
              notionApi.get(`/pages/${childId}`)
            );
            childTitle = await extractPageTitle(pageInfo.data) || childTitle || "(no title)";

const { notionApi, apiCallWithRetry } = require('./notion-api');
const { cache } = require('./cache');
const { CONFIG } = require('../config/notion-config');

// === Utility: Find Page by Title ===
async function findPageByTitle(title) {
  if (!title || typeof title !== 'string') {
    console.warn("Empty or invalid title provided to findPageByTitle");
    return null;
  }
  
  const normalizedInput = title.toLowerCase().trim();
  
  // Check cache first
  const cacheKey = `title:${normalizedInput}`;
  const cachedPage = cache.get(cacheKey);
  if (cachedPage) {
    return cachedPage;
  }
  
  try {
    const searchResponse = await apiCallWithRetry(() => 
      notionApi.post('/search', {
        query: title,
        filter: { property: "object", value: "page" },
        page_size: 10
      })
    );

    // No results
    if (!searchResponse.data.results.length) {
      return null;
    }

    // Use the enhanced title extraction for better matching
    const pages = await Promise.all(searchResponse.data.results.map(async (page) => {
      try {
        const extractedTitle = await extractPageTitle(page);
        return {
          page,
          title: extractedTitle
        };
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(`Error extracting title for page ${page.id}:`, err.message);
        return {
          page,
          title: `Untitled (${page.id.substring(0, 8)})`
        };
      }
    }));

    // Find exact match or closest match
    const exactMatch = pages.find(item => 
      item.title && item.title.toLowerCase() === normalizedInput
    );
    
    const match = exactMatch || null;
    
    // Cache the result
    if (match) {
      cache.set(cacheKey, match);
    }
    
    return match;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(`❌ Find page error for "${title}":`, error.message);
    return null;
  }
}

// === Utility: Enhanced title extraction function ===
async function extractPageTitle(page) {
  if (!page) {
    console.warn("Cannot extract title: page object is undefined");
    return "Untitled Page";
  }
  
  // Check cache first
  const cacheKey = page.id;
  if (!cacheKey) {
    console.warn("Cannot cache page title: missing page ID");
    return extractTitleUncached(page);
  }
  
  const cachedTitle = cache.get(cacheKey, 'titles');
  if (cachedTitle) {
    return cachedTitle;
  }

  // Extract title using helper function
  const extractedTitle = await extractTitleUncached(page);
  
  // Cache the result
  if (extractedTitle && cacheKey) {
    cache.set(cacheKey, extractedTitle, 'titles');
  }

  return extractedTitle;
}

// Helper function for title extraction logic
async function extractTitleUncached(page) {
  // Try to extract title from properties first (for pages and databases)
  if (page.properties) {
    // Check all title-like properties in descending order of likelihood
    const titleProps = ['title', 'Name', 'Feature', 'Title'];

    for (const prop of titleProps) {
      const titleArray = page.properties[prop]?.title;
      if (titleArray && titleArray.length > 0) {
        const textContent = titleArray[0]?.plain_text || titleArray[0]?.text?.content;
        if (textContent) {
          console.log(`✅ Found title in properties.${prop}: "${textContent}"`);
          return textContent;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // For direct title property (older Notion API format)
  if (page.title) {
    if (Array.isArray(page.title) && page.title.length > 0) {
      const textContent = page.title[0]?.plain_text || page.title[0]?.text?.content;
      if (textContent) {
        console.log(`✅ Found title in direct title array: "${textContent}"`);
        return textContent;
      }
    } else if (typeof page.title === 'string') {
      console.log(`✅ Found string title: "${page.title}"`);
      return page.title;
    }
  }

  // Try to get from page object
  if (page.child_page?.title) {
    console.log(`✅ Found title in child_page: "${page.child_page.title}"`);
    return page.child_page.title;
  }

  // Last resort: Extract from page content
  if (page.id) {
    try {
      return await extractTitleFromBlocks(page.id);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`❌ Failed to extract title from blocks for ${page.id}:`, err.message);
      return `Untitled Page (${page.id.substring(0, 8)})`;
    }
  }

  return `Untitled Page (${page.id ? page.id.substring(0, 8) : 'unknown'})`;
}

// === Utility: Enhanced title extraction from blocks ===
async function extractTitleFromBlocks(pageId) {
  try {
    const response = await apiCallWithRetry(() => 
      notionApi.get(`/blocks/${pageId}/children?page_size=50`)
    );

    const blocks = response.data.results;

    // First check for a child_page with title
    const childPageBlock = blocks.find(block => block.type === "child_page");
    if (childPageBlock?.child_page?.title) {
      const title = childPageBlock.child_page.title;
      console.log(`📄 Found child page title: ${title}`);
      return title;
    }

    // Look for the first heading block
    const headingTypes = ["heading_1", "heading_2", "heading_3"];
    const headingBlock = blocks.find(block => headingTypes.includes(block.type));

    if (headingBlock) {
      const blockType = headingBlock.type;
      const richText = headingBlock[blockType]?.rich_text || [];
      const title = richText.map(rt => rt.text?.content || '').join("").trim();

      if (title) {
        console.log(`✅ Found title in ${blockType}: "${title}"`);
        return title;
      }
    }

    // Try to get first paragraph text as fallback
    const paragraphBlock = blocks.find(block => block.type === "paragraph");
    if (paragraphBlock) {
      const richText = paragraphBlock.paragraph?.rich_text || [];
      const title = richText.map(rt => rt.text?.content || '').join("").trim();

      if (title) {
        console.log(`✅ Found title in paragraph: "${title}"`);
        return title;
      }
    }

    // Get page info directly as last resort
    try {
      const pageInfo = await apiCallWithRetry(() => 
        notionApi.get(`/pages/${pageId}`)
      );

      // Try to find any property that might contain a title
      const properties = pageInfo.data.properties;
      if (properties) {
        for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(properties)) {
          if (value.title && value.title.length > 0) {
            const title = value.title[0]?.plain_text || value.title[0]?.text?.content;
            if (title) {
              console.log(`✅ Found title in page properties.${key}: "${title}"`);
              return title;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`❌ Failed to fetch page info for ${pageId}:`, err.message);
    }

    console.log(`⚠️ No usable title found for ${pageId}`);
    return `Untitled Page (${pageId.substring(0, 8)})`;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`❌ Title extraction failed for ${pageId}:`, err.message);
    return `Untitled Page (${pageId.substring(0, 8)})`;
  }

          await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, Math.pow(2, attempt) * 500));

          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.error(`Error processing version for page ${page.id}:`, err.message);
          // Continue with other pages
        }
      }

      // Calculate next version number
      const newVersion = highestVersion + 1;
      const versionSuffix = newVersion < 10 ? `0${newVersion}` : `${newVersion}`;
      const newTitle = `${baseTitle} ${versionSuffix}`;

      // Defensive check for existing page with the same versioned title
      const duplicateCheck = await findPageByTitle(newTitle);
      if (duplicateCheck) {
        console.warn(`Version collision detected for "${newTitle}"`);

        // Retry with exponential backoff if we haven't exceeded max attempts
        if (attempt < maxVersionAttempts) {
          console.log(`Retrying version creation (attempt ${attempt + 1}/${maxVersionAttempts})...`);
          // Wait with exponential backoff
          await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, Math.pow(2, attempt) * 500));
          return createVersionedPage(baseTitle, content, attempt + 1);
        }

        throw new Error(`Version collision persists after ${maxVersionAttempts} attempts`);
      }
      
      // Create the new versioned page
      console.log(`Creating new version: "${newTitle}" (version ${newVersion})...`);

      const childrenBlocks = [
        createHeadingBlock(newTitle),
        createParagraphBlock(`Version ${newVersion} of "${baseTitle}" - Created ${new Date().toLocaleString()}`),
        // Optional: Add metadata or version history information
        createHeadingBlock("Version History", 3)
      ];
      
      // Add version history paragraph
      const versionHistory = Array.from(versionMap.keys()).sort((a, b) => a - b);
      childrenBlocks.push(
        createParagraphBlock(`This is version ${newVersion}. Previous versions: ${versionHistory.join(', ') || 'None'}`)
      );
      
      // Add content section
      childrenBlocks.push(createHeadingBlock("Content", 2));
      
      // Handle content blocks (which might be an array after splitting long content)
      const contentBlocks = createParagraphBlock(content);
      if (Array.isArray(contentBlocks)) {
        childrenBlocks.push(...contentBlocks);
      } else {
        childrenBlocks.push(contentBlocks);
      }

      const createRes = await apiCallWithRetry(() => 
        notionApi.post('/pages', {
          parent: { type: "page_id", page_id: CONFIG.NOTION_PARENT_PAGE_ID },
          properties: {
            title: [
              {
                type: "text",
                text: { content: newTitle }
              }
            ]
          },
          children: childrenBlocks
        })
      );

      return {
        pageId: createRes.data.id,
        newTitle,
        version: newVersion,
        versionHistory
      };
    };

    // Main execution logic
    console.log(`Attempting to write/replace page titled "${sanitizedTitle}"...`);
    const match = await findPageByTitle(sanitizedTitle);

    if (!match) {
      // Create first version of the page (no versioning needed yet)
      console.log(`Creating new page titled "${sanitizedTitle}"...`);
      
      const childrenBlocks = [
        createHeadingBlock(sanitizedTitle),
        createParagraphBlock(`Original version - Created ${new Date().toLocaleString()}`),
        createHeadingBlock("Content", 2)
      ];
      
      // Handle content blocks (which might be an array after splitting long content)
      const contentBlocks = createParagraphBlock(sanitizedContent);
      if (Array.isArray(contentBlocks)) {
        childrenBlocks.push(...contentBlocks);
      } else {
        childrenBlocks.push(contentBlocks);
      }
      
      const createRes = await apiCallWithRetry(() => 
        notionApi.post('/pages', {
          parent: { type: "page_id", page_id: CONFIG.NOTION_PARENT_PAGE_ID },
          properties: {
            title: [
              {
                type: "text",
                text: { content: sanitizedTitle }
              }
            ]
          },
          children: childrenBlocks
        })
      );

      const pageId = createRes.data.id;

      // Invalidate cache after creating a new page
      cache.clear();

      return res.json({ 
        success: true, 
        created: true, 
        pageId,
        message: "Created new page (first version)"
      });
    } else {
      // Page exists, create a versioned page
      try {
        const result = await createVersionedPage(sanitizedTitle, sanitizedContent);

        // Invalidate cache after creating a new version
        cache.clear();

        return res.json({ 
          success: true, 
          created: true, 
          versioned: true, 
          originalTitle: sanitizedTitle,
          newTitle: result.newTitle,
          version: result.version,
          versionHistory: result.versionHistory,
          pageId: result.pageId,
          message: `Created new version ${result.version} of the page`
        });
      } catch (versionError) {
        // Handle version creation errors specifically
        console.error("Version creation failed:", versionError);
        return res.status(409).json({ 
          error: versionError.message || "Failed to create versioned page",
          suggestion: "Try again later or with a different title"
        });
      }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    handleApiError(res, error, "write-page-by-title");

});

router.get("/read-memory", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const memoryDBId = CONFIG.NOTION_MEMORY_DB_ID;
    
    if (!memoryDBId) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: "Missing GPT_MEMORY in environment variables." });
    }
    
    const rawKey = req.query.key;
    let body = {};
    
    if (rawKey) {
      try {
        const normalizedKey = normalizeKey(rawKey);
        body = {
          filter: {
            property: "Key",
            title: { equals: normalizedKey }
          }
        };
      } catch (e) {
        return res.status(400).json({ 
          error: "Invalid key format.", 
          details: e.message 
        });
      }
    }

    const response = await apiCallWithRetry(() => 
      notionApi.post(`/databases/${memoryDBId}/query`, body)
    );

    const memory = response.data.results.map(page => {
      const key = page.properties.Key?.title?.[0]?.plain_text || "(no key)";
      const value = page.properties.Value?.rich_text?.[0]?.plain_text || "";
      const lastUpdated = page.properties.LastUpdated?.date?.start || null;
      return { key, value, lastUpdated, id: page.id };
    });

    if (rawKey && memory.length === 0) {
      return res.status(404).json({ 
        error: `Memory key '${rawKey}' not found.`,
        message: "No matching memory entry found"
      });
    }

    res.json({ 
      success: true, 
      memory: rawKey ? memory[0] : memory,
      count: memory.length
    });
  } catch (err) {
    handleApiError(res, err, "read-memory");
  }
});

router.patch("/create-memory", async (req, res) => {

    if (!memoryDBId) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: "Missing GPT_MEMORY in environment variables." });

    if (!line || typeof line !== 'string' || !line.includes(":")) {
      return res.status(400).json({ 
        error: "Missing or malformed memory line. Format must be 'key: value'" 
      });
    }

    const [keyPart, ...rest] = line.split(":");
    
    // Validate key is not empty after normalization
    const key = normalizeKey(keyPart);
    if (!key) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: "Key cannot be empty." });
    }
    
    const value = rest.join(":").trim();
    if (!value) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: "Value cannot be empty." });
    }

    // Check if key already exists to avoid duplicates
    const existingQuery = await apiCallWithRetry(() => 
      notionApi.post(`/databases/${memoryDBId}/query`, {
        filter: { property: "Key", title: { equals: key } }
      })
    );

    if (existingQuery.data.results.length > 0) {
      const existingId = existingQuery.data.results[0].id;
      
      // Update existing memory instead of creating a duplicate
      await apiCallWithRetry(() => 
        notionApi.patch(`/pages/${existingId}`, {
          properties: {
            Value: { rich_text: [{ text: { content: value } }] },
            LastUpdated: { date: { start: new Date().toISOString() } }
          }
        })
      );
      
      return res.json({ 
        success: true, 
        updated: true,
        pageId: existingId,
        message: `Updated existing memory with key '${keyPart.trim()}'`
      });
    }

    // Create new memory entry
    const response = await apiCallWithRetry(() => 
      notionApi.post('/pages', {
        parent: { database_id: memoryDBId },
        properties: {
          Key: { title: [{ text: { content: key } }] },
          Value: { rich_text: [{ text: { content: value } }] },
          LastUpdated: { date: { start: new Date().toISOString() } }
        }
      })
    );

    res.json({ 
      success: true, 
      created: true,
      pageId: response.data.id,
      message: `Created new memory with key '${keyPart.trim()}'`
    });
  } catch (err) {
    handleApiError(res, err, "create-memory");

});
